title: eludite.error_list.filter input
description: Filter the Error List as its toolbar does: the Errors, Warnings and Messages toggle buttons, the project dropdown and the search box (code and description, case-insensitive). Omitted members keep their current value. Filtering is local and instant; it changes what the window shows, never what diagnostics.list returns.

project.description: Show only this project's rows, by its Solution Explorer name; null or an empty string shows every project.

text.description: Show only rows whose code or description contains this text (case-insensitive); empty shows all.
